messages:
riley: Draft ready for review — product launch blog + webinar CTA matrix. TL;DR: primary CTA = webinar sign-up, secondary = download benchmarks, tertiary = contact sales. Draft here: https://drive.redwood/mock/launch-blog-draft
elaine: skimmed — overall good. small nit: put headline latency number up front. makes the hero hook stronger.
sophia: will pair with design on hero imagery tomorrow. also recommend we A/B the hero CTA copy: \"Register for webinar\" vs \"Save my seat\".
mukund: quick Q on gating — HubSpot form or gated download? If HS, we need: hidden fields for utm_campaign, model_benchmark, webinar_id, region.
ben: legal quick check: the sentence claiming \"~40% cost reduction\" needs a citation or a qualifier. either add parenthetical \"(vs baseline X on our benchmark)\" or remove.
riley: good catch Ben — I'll add a parenthetical and link to our benchmark doc /benchmarks/dedicated. also updating CTA copy options.
nina: inbound routing notes: webinar registrants -> HubSpot list "Webinar - Launch (Sept)" -> workflow: 1) confirmation email immediately, 2) 3-day reminder, 3) post-webinar follow up with trial credits. routing by region: APAC -> APAC SDR queue; EMEA -> EMEA SDR queue; otherwise NA.
mukund: UTM mapping suggestion: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_sept_2026, utm_content={cta_variant}. Also we should capture \"model_benchmark\" hidden field to feed into persona tagging.
riley: @nina do we have the workflow templates ready or should @sam own creating them?
sam: I can update HS forms/workflows today. Will add hidden fields and list mapping. question: do we want to filter out internal test domains (eg endswith @redwood.com)?
elaine: yes please filter internal domains.
sophia: design agree on CTA hierarchy: primary button \"Save my seat\" (accent), secondary text link to benchmarks, tertiary \"Contact sales\" as outline. will produce 3 variants for A/B.
ina: one more: marketing -> sales handoff: registrant with company domain and >50 seats should create a hot lead in Salesforce via HubSpot sync.
ben: legal ok with the added benchmark parenthetical. Approved. :white_check_mark:
leah: speaker confirm: I can do product demo + 5 min Q&A. will send 2-sentence bio + headshot by EOD Thursday.
marco: customer brief ready — will load a short quote about reducing inference costs. sending quote now to Riley.
ops-bot: reminder: publish checklist item #34 (blog -> webinar CTA mapping) assigned to riley, due 2026-09-20.
riley: thanks all. timeline: publish blog Mon 09:00 PT, webinar invite email Tue 10:00 PT. if no objections I will push updated draft Friday morning and tag for final approval.
sam: HubSpot form updated and tested. test submission succeeded (email + list + hidden fields). screenshot uploaded: https://drive.redwood/mock/hs-test-screenshot.png
riley: perfect — merging draft with changes (CTA copy variants, benchmark note, HubSpot mapping). final approval requested from @elaine and @sophia by EOD Fri. after that we move to publish queue. :party_parrot:
elaine: approving pending the hero latency stat placement — will confirm in the updated draft.
sophia: approve for design assets; will upload new hero and CTA variations by EOD Fri.
riley: great. assigning follow-ups: @sam (HS mappings & filters), @nina (workflows & SDR routing), @leah (bio + headshot), @marco (customer quote). will post updated draft link when done.
